candidates.change_summary: Change the require check to compare to tx.origin instead of Owner, which allows withdraw to succeed for the original owner only when tx.origin matches Owner and may allow other callers when forwarded by Owner-originated transactions.
Remove the require check entirely so anyone can call withdraw and send the contract balance to Owner.
Invert the require condition to require that the caller is NOT the Owner, preventing the owner from withdrawing but allowing others to trigger transfer to Owner.
Change transfer target from Owner to msg.sender so the caller receives the contract balance when withdraw is called by the owner.
Make withdraw use send instead of transfer, which changes gas forwarding and failure behavior observable when owner calls withdraw.
Replace low-level call without checking return value with a require around the call result so the call must succeed (revert on failure).
Replace the call by forwarding no value (value removed), so msg.value is not forwarded to the target.
Change the call to use a staticcall (making it non-state-changing on target) while keeping value forwarding removed, altering how external contract is invoked.
Add a require preventing any value from being sent by requiring msg.value == 0 before performing the call with forwarded value (thus reverting if value provided).
Invert the owner check so the function is callable only by non-owners (require msg.sender != Owner), changing who can execute the call.
